name: warapp-mcp
description: war.app (Warzone) game advisor for Claude — your games, maps, bonuses, board analysis and routes via the GameFeed API, plus your games list (waiting on you first), opponent scouting with your head-to-head, the live board, territory picks, cards, turn planning and submission, turn notifications, and chat through your signed-in war.app tab (ContextMint Bridge). Joining, leaving or surrendering a game, Begin on a speed first turn, picks, turn orders, withdrawing them, chat sends and linking a session (local only) are confirm-gated.

email.title: war.app email
email.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

api_token.title: war.app API token
api_token.description: Your API token, shown at https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in. Changing your password rotates it.

ws_port.title: Bridge port
ws_port.description: The fetchproxy bridge port the live-game tools use to reach your signed-in war.app tab. The whole fetchproxy fleet and ContextMint Bridge share 37149; override only for local testing (or when a host injects a per-registration port). Defaults to 37149.

env_file.title: Credentials file (optional)
env_file.description: Optional dotenv file holding WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN. Defaults to ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env.

transport.title: Transport (optional)
transport.description: How the live-game tools reach war.app: 'auto' (default — the chrome-less direct transport when a session is linked, else the browser bridge), 'direct', or 'fetchproxy' (browser bridge only).

session_file.title: Direct-transport session file (optional)
session_file.description: Where the linked direct-transport session is stored (default <data dir>/session.json). Local-only; a full-account credential kept at file mode 0600.

tools.name: warapp_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that war.app accepts your email and API token

tools.name: warapp_my_games
tools.description: List your war.app games, games waiting on you first (through your signed-in tab)

tools.name: warapp_list_open_games
tools.description: List open war.app games you could join: pace, seats, entry fee and rules (works without a browser once a session is linked)

tools.name: warapp_join_game
tools.description: Join an open war.app game from the open games list (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_leave_game
tools.description: Leave a game that has not started, giving up your seat (confirm-gated), confirmed from game state

tools.name: warapp_surrender
tools.description: Surrender a war.app game you are playing, or take back a pending surrender (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_begin_turn
tools.description: Press Begin in a speed-first-turn game to reveal the board and start your turn timer (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_scout_player
tools.description: Scout a war.app player: level, games, boots, ranked records and your head-to-head (through your signed-in tab)

tools.name: warapp_get_game
tools.description: Look up a war.app game: state, turn, players and who has committed, settings digest

tools.name: warapp_get_map
tools.description: Rank a game map's bonuses (easiest first) and find its chokepoints

tools.name: warapp_map_stats
tools.description: Opt-in (local, WARAPP_STATS=1): a map's most-picked starts, win rate by starting bonus and first-bonus turn, from finished ladder games

tools.name: warapp_analyze_board
tools.description: Advise a player from the board (GameFeed or live): income, closest bonuses, armies needed, threats

tools.name: warapp_strategy
tools.description: Strategy notes with sources, fitted to a game's format and settings, plus map notes: efficient bonuses, entry points, chokepoints

tools.name: warapp_plan_route
tools.description: Shortest path between two territories on a game's map

tools.name: warapp_get_live_board
tools.description: The live board through your war.app tab: owners, armies, fog, pickable territories

tools.name: warapp_get_my_picks
tools.description: Your submitted territory picks in priority order

tools.name: warapp_plan_turn
tools.description: Plan your turn from the live board: deploys and moves by name, expected bonuses, and submit-ready orders

tools.name: warapp_check_plan
tools.description: Stress-test a list of orders before submitting: the replies one enemy deploy could make, and what each would cost you

tools.name: warapp_track_opponents
tools.description: Track each opponent over your board history: deploys per turn, income, armies hidden in the fog, and bonuses that could explain the gap

tools.name: warapp_locate_opponents
tools.description: Guess where each opponent is and what it may be doing: what you saw kept apart from likely starts, hidden territories, approaches and what to prepare for

tools.name: warapp_plan_picks
tools.description: Plan your territory picks: a ranked list in a compact primary and fallback group, with reasons and submit-ready ids

tools.name: warapp_submit_picks
tools.description: Submit territory picks (confirm-gated), verified by reading them back

tools.name: warapp_submit_turn
tools.description: Commit your turn's orders (confirm-gated), validated on the live board and confirmed from game state

tools.name: warapp_uncommit_turn
tools.description: Withdraw your committed orders for the current turn so you can submit corrected ones (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_get_chat
tools.description: Read a game's chat

tools.name: warapp_send_chat
tools.description: Post a game chat message, public or private (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_wait_for_turn
tools.description: Wait until one of your games is waiting on you, woken by war.app's push notifications

tools.name: warapp_recent_events
tools.description: List the game-update pushes this server has received

tools.name: warapp_session_status
tools.description: Report whether a war.app session is linked for the direct (no-browser) transport, its age, and the active transport (never the cookie)

tools.name: warapp_link_session
tools.description: Link your signed-in war.app session once for the direct (no-browser) transport, storing the cookie locally (confirm-gated)
